triage.summary: AHU-4 is moving 40% less air at the same fan speed while using more power. The other units are normal, so this is specific to AHU-4.
key_evidence: Airflow 1,340 CFM vs normal 2,250 CFM (-15.2σ) at a constant 75% fan speed
Power rose from 5.5 to 7.6 kW over the last 30 minutes
All sensors are changing normally and within range

evidence: Airflow fell 40% (2250 to 1340 CFM) in 15 minutes while fan speed stayed at 75%
Compressor power rose from 5.5 to 7.6 kW to keep the room at 23 °C
Supply air got colder (16 to 11 °C): less air is passing through the coil
Similar incident on AHU-4 on 2026-07-12 was a clogged filter

energy.explanation: The compressor is working about 2 kW harder to push enough cold air through the blocked filter. If not fixed, AHU-4 wastes about 22 kWh (INR 185) per day.

recommendation.action: Inspect and replace the AHU-4 supply air filter
checklist: Inspect the filter bank and replace clogged filters
Check the filter pressure drop after replacement
Confirm airflow returns above 2100 CFM at 75% fan speed
